packages.description: List of per-package configuration blocks. Each item configures one package. If empty, only default directives apply.

packages[].ignore_candidate_mismatch.description: If true, ignore this package when candidate version differs from newest official version.

packages[].ignore_version_decrease.description: If true, ignore this package when installed version is older than candidate version.

packages[].ignore_non_candidate.description: If true, ignore this package when no candidate version exists (e.g., broken state).

default_ignore_candidate_mismatch.description: Global default: whether to ignore candidate-version mismatches by default.

default_ignore_version_decrease.description: Global default: whether to ignore version decreases (installed < candidate) by default.

default_ignore_non_candidate.description: Global default: whether to ignore packages without a candidate version by default.
